key_insight: A large-scale benchmark shows that quantum neural network performance for financial forecasting depends more on circuit design choices than on parameter count, with the best model reaching R² = 0.985 and beating a classical BiLSTM.
engineering_relevance: The study provides practical design guidance for building more accurate and noise-resilient QNNs for regression tasks on near-term quantum hardware.
method: Compared encoding methods, ansatz designs, qubit counts, layer depths, and cost functions
Evaluated both simulator performance and execution on IQM Emerald hardware
evidence_signal: The abstract reports systematic evaluation of 1,368 models on GBP/USD forecasting using accuracy, computational cost, and convergence, plus hardware-noise testing on IQM Emerald.
watch_item: Hardware deployment remains constrained by gate errors and decoherence, so high simulator accuracy may not translate directly to real-device performance.
paper_title: Large-Scale Benchmarking of Quantum Neural Network Configurations for Financial Time Series Forecasting
